data.one_liner: Collection of pre-built transition and layout builders for AnimatedSwitcher
data.what_it_does: Provides ready‑made transition and layout functions that can be passed to AnimatedSwitcher. Includes fade, rotation, zoom, flip, shake, and slide effects with customizable directions.
use_when: You want to quickly add visual flair to widget switches
You prefer not to write custom transitionBuilder logic
You need a variety of built‑in effects for prototyping
avoid_when: You need highly custom or stateful transitions that depend on external data
You are building a large, performance‑critical animation system that requires fine‑grained control
strengths: Works out of the box with standard AnimatedSwitcher
weaknesses: No support for custom animation curves beyond what AnimatedSwitcher offers
No stateful or complex animation logic
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import package

alternatives.name: value_layout_builder
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides layout builders for AnimatedSwitcher but not transition effects

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers responsive layouts, not transition effects

data.minimal_example:
AnimatedSwitcher(
  duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 500),
  transitionBuilder: AnimatedSwitcherTransitions.flipY,
  layoutBuilder: AnimatedSwitcherLayouts.inOut,
  child: Text('$counter', key: ValueKey(counter)),
)
